note: Data for tools/rooting/retire_check.py, the rejecting retirement gate for the binned Slang derivation route. binned_prefixes and binned_files name what must be absent; reference_surfaces name the forms that must not reference it (Lean imports, Lake roots, zero_axioms.json registrations, the trace_check.py Run/Derives acceptance). The self_test block carries a synthetic clean tree and one mutation per rule so --self-test and --controls need no Lean, Rust or network and never touch the repository tree.

reference_surfaces.title: Lean import of a binned module
Generator cannot resurrect the binned route (tools/slang/export.py)

rules.title: Binned path present
rules.description: A file under proof/corpus/Slang/Derivation/ or proof/corpus/Slang/Generated/Trace/ exists in the tree.

rules.title: Lean import of a binned module
rules.description: A .lean file under proof/ imports Slang.Derivation.* or Slang.Generated.Trace.*.

rules.title: Lake root still registered
rules.description: proof/corpus/lakefile.lean still lists a Slang.Derivation.* or Slang.Generated.Trace.* Lake root.

rules.title: Registry still registers the route
rules.description: tools/slang/zero_axioms.json still names a binned module or source path.

rules.title: Run/Derives acceptance still active
rules.description: tools/slang/trace_check.py still carries the DecodeTrace.Run/Derives acceptance (PHASE_MODULES mapping and witness-type check).

rules.title: Generator can resurrect the binned route
rules.description: tools/slang/export.py still names the binned Slang.Derivation / Slang.Generated.Trace route, or emits an unbounded recursion/heartbeat option (maxHeartbeats 0, maxRecDepth 1000000).

rules.title: Reference surface missing
rules.description: A reference surface the gate must read is absent, so retirement cannot be verified.
